data.name: Abbasi
data.gender_notes: Abbasi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic name 'Abd (servant) and Abbas, an honorific name of Imam Ali. The name signifies devotion and service to God and the Prophet. The name Abbasi carries the meaning “Servant of Abbas” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abbasi usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of abbas and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes dedication and loyalty to the Prophet Muhammad and Imam Ali.
data.etymology: Abbasi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of Abbas.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abbasi total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Abbasi holds significant cultural importance in Islamic communities. The name is believed to have originated from the Arabic word 'Abbas’, an honorific title given to Imam Ali, the fourth righteous caliph and a cousin and son-in-law of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). The use of this name in Islamic history symbolizes the Rememberance of Imam Ali, his spiritual and temporal leadership and legacy, and his significant role in the Islamic community.
data.spiritual_significance: The name 'Abbasi holds strong spiritual significance as it derives from 'Abd, the Arabic root 'abd, meaning servant. This denotes a deep and humble commitment to serving and obeying Allah (SWT) and seeking nearness to Him. The name also symbolizes the devotion and service to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his community. The individual named 'Abbasi is expected to strive towards attaining closeness to Allah and living a righteous life based on Islamic principles and values.
